Historically, the record for most assists in Premier League history is Ryan Giggs (though he played for Manchester United). Actually, the all-time assists leader is Ryan Giggs with 162 assists. However, the question might refer to the current season? But the user didn't specify a season. So likely they want the all-time record. The answer: Ryan Giggs.
